title: THE BIGGEST FISH IN THE SEA IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK

beats.label: OPEN OCEAN
beats.narration: You're floating in the open ocean. The water is dark, cold, and silent beneath you. Something massive just passed below.
Your mind does the math. A fin cutting the surface. Jaws. The ocean's most feared machine.

beats.label: NOT WHAT YOU THINK
beats.narration: But the giant down here is not the monster you're picturing.

beats.label: THE BIGGEST FISH ON EARTH
beats.narration: This is a whale shark. The largest fish on Earth, bigger than a school bus, cruising calmly beside you.

beats.label: 41 FT · 47,000 LBS
beats.narration: The largest confirmed one ever measured stretched past forty feet, and weighed nearly fifty thousand pounds.

beats.label: THOUSANDS OF KM
beats.narration: Marine biologists have tracked them migrating thousands of kilometers across open ocean, diving more than a kilometer deep.

beats.label: GENTLE GIANT
beats.narration: Divers have swum beside them for decades. They call it the gentle giant of the sea, for good reason.

beats.label: 300 ROWS OF TEETH
beats.narration: Its mouth is over a meter wide, lined with three hundred rows of tiny teeth. But it never uses them to bite. Instead, it filters the ocean, straining plankton and krill by the ton.

beats.label: 0 ATTACKS. EVER.
beats.narration: In all of recorded history, there has never been a single fatal whale shark attack on a human. Not one.

beats.label: SUBSCRIBE
beats.narration: So if you ever meet the biggest fish in the ocean, the only thing it wants from you is to swim out of the way. If this changed how you see sharks, subscribe for more deep-sea stories.
